description:
A former network support specialist, Marcus Webb, has left the organization. As part of the offboarding security procedure, you need to disable his FreeScout help desk account.

Perform the following:
1. Log in to FreeScout as the administrator (admin@helpdesk.local / Admin123!) at http://localhost:8080
2. Navigate to user management (Manage > Users)
3. Find the user 'Marcus Webb' (marcus.webb@helpdesk.local)
4. Disable (deactivate) his account

IMPORTANT: The account must be DISABLED, not DELETED. The user record and conversation history must be preserved for audit compliance. After completing the task, Marcus Webb's account should show as inactive/disabled in the system.
